---
title: "Density Peak Analysis (Lite)"
subtitle: "Compute centroids and correlations for VAE thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Compute density peaks, centroids, Spearman correlations, normal-repeated structure, and plot limits for 2 thresholds x 15 dimension pairs = 30 iterations.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-custom-functions

source(here("custom_func/find_highest_density_points.R"))
```

## Constants

```{r}
#| label: constants

THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)

trajectory_colors <- c(
  stable_normal = "#1f77b4",
  normal2mci = "#ff7f0e",
  stable_mci = "#2ca02c",
  normal2incid = "#d62728",
  mci2incid = "#9467bd",
  prev_dementia = "#8c564b"
)

dementia_categories <- c(
  "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid",
  "mci2incid", "prev_dementia"
)
```

## Load Embeddings

```{r}
#| label: load-embeddings

embeddings <- THRESHOLDS |>
  set_names(paste0("threshold_", THRESHOLDS)) |>
  map(\(t) read_rds(here(glue("VAE/lite/output/embedding_threshold_{t}.rds"))))

walk2(names(embeddings), embeddings, \(nm, emb) {
  message(glue("{nm}: {nrow(emb)} subjects"))
})
```

## Calculate Plot Limits

Quantile-based plot limits (0.0005, 0.9995) for each VAE dimension per threshold.

```{r}
#| label: calculate-plot-limits

plot_limits_list <- map(embeddings, \(data) {
  data |>
    select(starts_with("vae_")) |>
    # reframe(across(everything(), \(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.0005, 0.9995))))
    reframe(across(everything(), \(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.005, 0.995))))
})

message(glue("Plot limits computed for {length(plot_limits_list)} thresholds"))
```

## Create Normal-Repeated Structure

Pair each dementia category with stable_normal for downstream visualization.

```{r}
#| label: create-normal-repeated

normal_repeated_list <- map(embeddings, \(data) {
  dementia_categories |>
    set_names() |>
    map(\(cat) data |> filter(demcat %in% c("stable_normal", cat))) |>
    list_rbind(names_to = "demcat_grand") |>
    mutate(
      demcat_sub = if_else(demcat == "stable_normal", "stable_normal", "demented"),
      demcat_grand = fct_relevel(demcat_grand, dementia_categories)
    )
})

message(glue("Normal-repeated structure created for {length(normal_repeated_list)} thresholds"))
```

## Create Dimension Pair Backbone

```{r}
#| label: create-backbone

backbone <- expand_grid(
  threshold = names(embeddings),
  dimx = glue("vae_{1:6}"),
  dimy = glue("vae_{1:6}")
) |>
  filter(dimx < dimy)

message(glue("Backbone rows: {nrow(backbone)} ({length(THRESHOLDS)} thresholds x 15 dim pairs)"))
```

## Density Peak Computation

```{r}
#| label: find-density-peaks

tictoc::tic("Density peak computation")

density_peaks_list <- backbone |>
  pmap(\(threshold, dimx, dimy) {
    data <- embeddings[[threshold]]

    result <- try(
      find_highest_density_points(
        data,
        dim_cols = c(dimx, dimy),
        category_col = "demcat",
        density_threshold = 0.9,
        grid_resolution = 200,
        bandwidth = "nrd0",
        min_points = 20
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    if (inherits(result, "try-error")) return(NULL)

    result |>
      mutate(threshold = threshold, dimx = dimx, dimy = dimy)
  }) |>
  discard(is.null) |>
  list_rbind()

tictoc::toc()

glimpse(density_peaks_list)
```

## Calculate Centroids

```{r}
#| label: calculate-centroids

centroids <- density_peaks_list |>
  summarise(
    n_high_density_points = n(),
    x_mean = mean(x_highest_densities),
    y_mean = mean(y_highest_densities),
    x_median = median(x_highest_densities),
    y_median = median(y_highest_densities),
    x_sd = sd(x_highest_densities, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_sd = sd(y_highest_densities, na.rm = TRUE),
    x_range = max(x_highest_densities) - min(x_highest_densities),
    y_range = max(y_highest_densities) - min(y_highest_densities),
    mean_density = mean(density_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(threshold, dimx, dimy, demcat)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = "trajectory_evolution",
    spread_radius = replace_na(sqrt(x_sd^2 + y_sd^2), 0)
  )

glimpse(centroids)
```

## Compute Correlation with Dementia Trajectory

```{r}
#| label: compute-correlation

progression_order <- c(
  "normal2mci", "stable_normal", "stable_mci",
  "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev_dementia"
)

cor_centroids_with_demcat <- centroids |>
  mutate(
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, progression_order),
    demcat_int = as.integer(demcat)
  ) |>
  filter(demcat != "stable_normal") |>
  summarise(
    across(matches("_mean|_median"), \(x) cor(x, demcat_int, method = "spearman")),
    .by = c(threshold, dimx, dimy)
  )

glimpse(cor_centroids_with_demcat)
```

## Save Results

```{r}
#| label: save-results

output_dir <- here("VAE/lite/DPS/output")
fs::dir_create(output_dir)

# Save per-threshold files
for (threshold in names(embeddings)) {
  t_num <- str_extract(threshold, "\\d+")

  centroids |>
    filter(threshold == !!threshold) |>
    write_rds(here(output_dir, glue("centroids_threshold_{t_num}.rds")))

  cor_centroids_with_demcat |>
    filter(threshold == !!threshold) |>
    write_rds(here(output_dir, glue("cor_centroids_threshold_{t_num}.rds")))

  normal_repeated_list[[threshold]] |>
    write_rds(here(output_dir, glue("normal_repeated_threshold_{t_num}.rds")))

  plot_limits_list[[threshold]] |>
    write_rds(here(output_dir, glue("plot_limits_threshold_{t_num}.rds")))
}

message("Saved per-threshold files: centroids, cor_centroids, normal_repeated, plot_limits")
```
